title: Megurine Luka — Gentle Wake-Up Call〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This way, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Are we all still together?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Where do you think she's taking us today?

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Probably another really amazing place! I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, it's a very fun place.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A place where the sky is blue, the clouds are fluffy and the sea is so sparkly and beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's the perfect place to take a nap♪

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line:
Wow! That sounds really nice!
I can't wait to take a nap there!

rows.Speaker: KAITO's Voice
rows.Line: Everyone!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds like KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: Hey, look! He's over there!
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We were wondering where you'd gone. You were with the plushies.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What are you guys doing? Going for a walk?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We were taking a napping tour.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: A napping tour...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Umm... What does that actually involve?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't know, but it sounds fun☆

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's very fun.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We're going around to all of the best napping spots that I've discovered and trying them out.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So you're taking naps in lots of different places?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's right.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, that does sound like fun!
We'll get to have so many different dreams!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, we will.
I strongly recommend sleeping on the stage.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The stage?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, it's very fun.
When you sleep on the stage, you get to have dreams about all kinds of shows.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I suggest sleeping there whenever you feel like taking a smile-filled nap.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, that sounds wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I always wondered why you spent so much time sleeping on the stage. It's one of your favorite spots!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I'm still not sure how to feel...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's perfectly safe.
Why don't we all try taking a nap together♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There's also... Oh, the ship. I recommend that too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The Pegasus Special Deluxe Wonder?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it's nice to get rocked to sleep while listening to the waves.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It does sound very appealing when you put it that way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I agree.
I might go take a nap there sometime.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The Ferris wheel and hot air balloon are also fun places to take naps.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, the hot air balloon?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Aren't you afraid of falling, sleeping up that high?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's like sleeping on a cloud. It's very nice and comfy.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You've taken naps in so many different places...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We'll be sure to check the Ferris wheel and hot air balloon the next time we can't find you, Luka...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But still, I didn't realize our SEKAI offered so many different sleep experiences.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I feel like taking a nap now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too! Me too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, why don't you all join the napping tour too?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. This is turning into a very relaxing day.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If you all have fun, then I'd like to invite Tsukasa and the others next time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It sounded like their show for the workshop is finished, so it would be nice to give them an opportunity to relax.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Napping with everyone... That sounds very enjoyable.
